items.criterion: Access r/LocalLLaMA on Reddit without signing in
items.description: Navigate to https://www.reddit.com/r/LocalLLaMA/ (or remain on it if already there) and attempt to view the subreddit feed while not signed in. Full credit if subreddit content is visible without login. Full credit if access is prevented by a login wall, CAPTCHA, rate-limit, geo-block, or similar external blocker and the agent clearly reports the blocker and what was attempted. Partial credit if the agent makes an unclear/insufficient attempt to access before stopping. No credit if the agent signs in or does not attempt to access the subreddit.

items.criterion: Verify and apply 'Top' sort and 'This Week' time filter
items.description: Confirm the feed is sorted by 'Top' and the time range is set to 'This Week'. Full credit if both are explicitly set/verified via UI controls or an equivalent method (e.g., URL parameters like sort=top and t=week, or using old.reddit where available). If Reddit UI/experiments/blocking prevent applying or verifying one or both filters, full credit is awarded if the agent makes a reasonable attempt and clearly reports the limitation and what could/could not be verified. Partial credit if only one of the two (Top or This Week) is correctly set/verified when the other was reasonably accessible.

items.criterion: Identify the #1 post under Top/This Week and report title and score
items.description: From the Top + This Week view, report the exact title and visible score for the #1 ranked post. Full credit if both title and score match the #1 post shown. If the #1 post is identifiable but the score is not visible (e.g., scores hidden due to UI state/AB test) or content fails to load due to external issues, award full credit if the agent reports the #1 post title and clearly states the score is not observable/available (or vice versa, if title is blocked but score is visible). Partial credit if only title or only score is provided despite both being visible, or if minor transcription errors occur. No credit if the reported post is not #1 when the correct view is available.

items.criterion: Respect constraints (no sign-in and no interactions like vote/comment/save/post)
items.description: Complete the task without signing in and without voting, commenting, saving, hiding, reporting, or creating a post. Full credit if no prohibited interactions are performed. No credit if the agent signs in or performs any prohibited action.

items.criterion: Stop after recording the #1 post title and score
items.description: End the workflow once Top and This Week are verified (or limitations are clearly documented) and the #1 post title and score (or any unavailability of either) are recorded, without unnecessary extra browsing/actions. Full credit if the agent stops at the stated stopping condition. Partial credit if minor extra navigation occurs but no constraints are violated. No credit if the agent continues significantly beyond the stopping condition or begins unrelated actions.
